summary: Three distinct Raleigh retail refinance opportunities qualify after applying business rules and the executed/effective source updates on or before 2026-08-31: Elm Square 1 (R6968, matures 2027-01-15, $8.64M), Elm Point 3 (R7631, matures 2027-03-15, $9.94M), and Elm Crossing 18 (R7798, matures 2027-04-15, $10.58M). R4437 duplicates R6968's entity and is excluded from the shortlist. The R7631 release update is dated after cutoff and does not disqualify. Outstanding balances are unknown across all records.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null for every record; loan_amount is original_principal, not current balance.
The R7631 recorded release (U-R7631-2) is dated after the 2026-08-31 evidence cutoff; if the analysis were extended past cutoff this lead would drop off.
No sponsor/borrower-side CFO or Head of Acquisitions was published for any record; all qualifying contacts are Directors of Finance.
Email addresses are the published business emails supplied in the extracts; deliverability not independently verified.
Dedup keyed on entity_id; if the two R6968/R4437 sources ever diverged on facts, the tie-break rule (keep first-listed) would need review.
